title: Servers
description: Host performance from the OpenTelemetry hostmetrics receiver (system.*). Provisioned from git (kube-cluster/apps/grafana/dashboards/cluster); README there has the runbook.

links.title: Kubernetes Containers
links.tooltip: Containers on the selected k8s nodes

panels.title: Servers not reporting
panels.description: Selected servers whose newest host metric is over 5 minutes old. Non-zero: the host is down, its collector stopped, or the metrics pipeline lags (then every host goes stale at once).

targets.expr: count(time() - max by ("host.name") (tlast_over_time({__name__="system.cpu.load_average.1m", host.name=~"$server"}[1d])) > 300) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst disk time-to-full
panels.description: Shortest predicted time until a host filesystem is full, from its 6h trend. Red < 4h, orange < 24h, yellow < 7d. See *Disk space*.

targets.expr: min(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) / -deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) and deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) < 0) or vector(1e+10)

panels.title: Busiest CPU
panels.description: Highest 5m CPU busy share among the selected servers.

targets.expr: topk(1, label_move(1 - sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="idle"}[5m])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[5m])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Highest iowait
panels.description: Highest 5m share of CPU time spent waiting for disk I/O.

targets.expr: topk(1, label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="wait"}[5m])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[5m])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Highest load per core
panels.description: 5m load average divided by logical CPUs. Above 1 means runnable or I/O-blocked tasks are queueing.

targets.expr: topk(1, label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.load_average.5m", host.name=~"$server"}) / max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.logical.count", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Soonest memory exhaustion
panels.description: Shortest time until available memory runs out on its 1h trend, counted only where under a quarter is left and shrinking.

targets.expr: min((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"})) / -deriv((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}))[1h:1m]) and deriv((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}))[1h:1m]) < 0 and (max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"})) < 0.25 * max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"})) or vector(1e+10)

panels.title: Server health
panels.description:
One row per server, now. Click a server to filter the dashboard or jump to its containers.

- **Disk TTF / Memory TTF**: time to full from the trend; *not filling* / empty means no risk. These drive the alerts, not fixed percentages.
- **iowait** high with low CPU busy: storage is the bottleneck (see *Disk I/O*). **steal** high: the hypervisor is overcommitted.
- **Net** on k8s nodes is pod traffic only (hostmetrics runs in a pod netns there).

targets.expr: label_move(time() - max by ("host.name") (tlast_over_time({__name__="system.cpu.load_average.1m", host.name=~"$server"}[1d])), "host.name", "server")
label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.uptime", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(1 - sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="idle"}[5m])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[5m])), "host.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="wait"}[5m])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[5m])), "host.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="steal"}[5m])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[5m])), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.load_average.5m", host.name=~"$server"}) / max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.logical.count", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}) / max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"})) / -deriv((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}))[1h:1m]) and deriv((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}))[1h:1m]) < 0 and (max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"})) < 0.25 * max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"})) or (max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) * 0 + 1e+10), "host.name", "server")
label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.paging.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(min by ("host.name") (max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) / -deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) and deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) < 0) or (max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) * 0 + 1e+10), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name") (max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.utilization", host.name=~"$server", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})), "host.name", "server")

(label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.network.io", host.name=~"$server", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*", direction="receive", k8s.node.name=""}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")) or (label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") (rate({__name__="k8s.pod.network.io", k8s.node.name=~"$server", direction="receive"}[$__rate_interval])), "k8s.node.name", "server"))

(label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.network.io", host.name=~"$server", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*", direction="transmit", k8s.node.name=""}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")) or (label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name") (rate({__name__="k8s.pod.network.io", k8s.node.name=~"$server", direction="transmit"}[$__rate_interval])), "k8s.node.name", "server"))

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Grafana alerts currently firing or pending (all folders).

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description:
Share of CPU time not idle.

**Bad:** pinned near 100% for long stretches; requests queue and latency rises. **Fix:** find the consumer (on k8s nodes: *Top pods by CPU* below), move or limit it, or add cores.

targets.expr: label_move(1 - sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: CPU time by mode
panels.description:
Where CPU time goes, summed over the selected servers (select one server to see only it).

- **user/system** high: real compute load.
- **wait** (iowait): waiting on disk, see *Disk I/O*.
- **steal**: the hypervisor gave the time to other VMs; move VMs or reduce overcommit.
- **softirq/interrupt** high: network or storage interrupt load, often one core (see *Hottest core*).

targets.expr: sum by (state) (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(sum(rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: iowait
panels.description:
Share of CPU time idle while waiting for disk I/O.

**Bad:** sustained > 20-40%: the disk or the network storage (Ceph RBD/CephFS) is too slow for the load. **Fix:** check *Disk I/O* latency and queue depth; on Ceph-backed nodes look at the Ceph nodes too.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="wait"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Steal
panels.description:
Share of CPU time the hypervisor ran other guests while this VM wanted to run.

**Bad:** sustained > 10-25%; the VM is slow for reasons inside the guest cannot show. **Fix:** rebalance VMs across hypervisors or lower vCPU overcommit.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="steal"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ("host.name") (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description:
5m load average / logical CPUs. Linux load counts tasks running **and** blocked on I/O.

**Bad:** sustained > 1 with high CPU busy: CPU saturation; > 1 with low busy and high iowait: I/O saturation.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.load_average.5m", host.name=~"$server"}) / max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.cpu.logical.count", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Hottest core
panels.description:
Busy share of the busiest single core. Hosts that report only aggregate CPU (k8s nodes) show their average.

**Bad:** one core near 100% while the host average is low: a single-threaded process or an interrupt/softirq hotspot (e.g. one NIC queue). **Fix:** spread IRQs (irqbalance, RSS queues) or scale the process out.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name") (1 - sum by ("host.name", cpu) (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server", state="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ("host.name", cpu) (rate({__name__="system.cpu.time", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]))), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description:
Non-reclaimable memory (excludes page cache and reclaimable slab) / total.

A high but flat line is fine. What matters is the trend: see *Available memory trend* and the TTF in *Server health*.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}) / max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Available memory
panels.description:
Total minus non-reclaimable memory: what new allocations can get before the kernel must swap or OOM-kill.

**Bad:** steadily falling towards 0. **Fix:** find the growing process (k8s nodes: *Top pods by memory*); restart a leaking service, add limits or memory.

targets.expr: label_move((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"})), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Available memory trend
panels.description:
Change in available memory per hour (1h slope). Negative = shrinking.

**Bad:** negative for hours (a leak); the memory TTF alert fires once less than a quarter is left and it would run out within 2h.

targets.expr: label_move(deriv((max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.limit", host.name=~"$server"}) - max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}))[1h:5m]) * 3600, "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Memory composition
panels.description:
Summed over the selected servers. Cached/buffered and slab_reclaimable are given back under pressure; *used* and *slab_unreclaimable* are not.

**Bad:** slab_unreclaimable growing without bound (kernel object leak, e.g. dentries, conntrack).

targets.expr: sum by (state) (max by ("host.name", state) ({__name__="system.memory.usage", host.name=~"$server"}))

panels.title: Swap used
panels.description:
Swap in use (only hosts with swap).

**Bad:** growing together with swap-in activity: the working set does not fit in RAM.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.paging.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Swap activity
panels.description:
Pages swapped in and out per second.

**Bad:** sustained swap-in: thrashing, every access may wait on disk. **Fix:** free memory or add RAM. A spike right after a collector restart is a counter artefact.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name", direction) (rate({__name__="system.paging.operations", host.name=~"$server", type="major"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description:
Host filesystems (k8s PVC mounts are on the Kubernetes Containers dashboard).

- **Growth/day**: usage change per day from the 6h trend.
- **Time to full**: free space / shrink rate; *not filling* when stable or shrinking. Alerts fire at < 24h (warning) and < 4h or ≥ 97% full (critical), only when over half full.
- **Fix:** find what grows (logs, images, VictoriaMetrics/Kafka data), prune or grow the disk.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) + max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) + max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="reserved", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.utilization", host.name=~"$server", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}), "host.name", "server")

label_move(-deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) * 86400, "host.name", "server")

label_move((max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) / -deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) and deriv(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m]) < 0) or (max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) * 0 + 1e+10), "host.name", "server")

label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) / (max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) + max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Filesystem used
panels.description: Used share per filesystem.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.utilization", host.name=~"$server", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Free space projected in 24h
panels.description: Where free space will be in 24h if the 6h trend continues. **Below 0 = fills within a day.**

targets.expr: label_move(predict_linear(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})[6h:5m], 86400), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Inodes used
panels.description: Used inode share. **Bad:** climbing while bytes are free: millions of small files (caches, mail, session files); the filesystem reports full anyway.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) / (max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="used", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"}) + max by ("host.name", mountpoint) ({__name__="system.filesystem.inodes.usage", host.name=~"$server", state="free", mountpoint!~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/.*|/var/lib/containers/.*|/run/.*"})), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Device utilisation (top 10)
panels.description:
Share of time the device had I/O in flight. On k8s nodes **rbdN** are Ceph RBD PVCs, on Ceph nodes **casN-M** are the OSD devices.

**Bad:** near 100% together with rising latency: the device is saturated (for SSD/RBD, which serve in parallel, latency and queue matter more).

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(max by ("host.name", device) (rate({__name__="system.disk.io_time", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Latency per operation (top 10)
panels.description:
Average time per completed read/write.

**Bad:** HDD > 20-50ms, SSD/NVMe > 5ms, RBD > 10-20ms sustained. **Fix:** find the heavy writer (*Disk I/O by pod* on the container dashboard), check Ceph health and the OSD devices on the Ceph nodes.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("host.name", device, direction) (rate({__name__="system.disk.operation_time", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by ("host.name", device, direction) (rate({__name__="system.disk.operations", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Queue depth (top 10)
panels.description:
Average number of I/Os in flight (weighted I/O time per second).

**Bad:** consistently above what the device can serve in parallel (1-2 for HDD); requests are waiting.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(max by ("host.name", device) (rate({__name__="system.disk.weighted_io_time", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Throughput (top 10)
panels.description: Bytes read + written per second per device.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("host.name", device) (rate({__name__="system.disk.io", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: IOPS (top 10)
panels.description:
Completed operations per second per device.

**Bad:** high IOPS with small throughput and high latency: random small I/O (databases, fsync-heavy apps); move them to faster storage.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("host.name", device) (rate({__name__="system.disk.operations", host.name=~"$server", device!~"dm-.*|loop.*|(sd|vd|xvd)[a-z]+[0-9]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p[0-9]+", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server"))

panels.title: Blocked processes
panels.description:
Processes in uninterruptible sleep (D state), usually waiting on disk or network storage. Not reported by k8s nodes.

**Bad:** sustained > 0 rising with iowait: storage stalls; a hung NFS/CephFS mount pins them forever.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("host.name") ({__name__="system.processes.count", host.name=~"$server", status="blocked"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description:
Received (up) and transmitted (down) per server. **k8s nodes show the sum of their pods' traffic**: hostmetrics there runs in a pod netns, and host-network traffic (Ceph RBD/CephFS kernel clients, hostNetwork pods) is not visible.

**Bad:** flat-topped at the link speed: saturated link. **Fix:** find the top talker (*Network by pod* on the container dashboard).

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name", direction) (rate({__name__="system.network.io", host.name=~"$server", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*", k8s.node.name=""}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")
label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name", direction) (rate({__name__="k8s.pod.network.io", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "k8s.node.name", "server")

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description:
Packets per second dropped or with errors. A small constant drop rate (unknown protocols, multicast) is normal.

**Bad:** errors > 0 (cabling, NIC, MTU mismatch) or drops rising with traffic (ring buffer or socket backlog overflow). Alert: errors+drops > 1% of packets for 15m.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name", direction) (rate({__name__="system.network.errors", host.name=~"$server", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*", k8s.node.name=""}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")

label_move(sum by ("host.name", direction) (rate({__name__="system.network.dropped", host.name=~"$server", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*", k8s.node.name=""}[$__rate_interval])), "host.name", "server")
label_move(sum by ("k8s.node.name", direction) (rate({__name__="k8s.pod.network.errors", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "k8s.node.name", "server")

panels.title: TCP connections
panels.description:
Connections by state (servers outside k8s).

- **CLOSE_WAIT** growing: an application does not close sockets (leak).
- **TIME_WAIT** in the tens of thousands: connection churn; use keep-alive / pooling.
- **SYN_RECV** high: SYN flood or a full accept backlog.

targets.expr: label_move(sum by ("host.name", state) ({__name__="system.network.connections", host.name=~"$server", protocol="tcp", k8s.node.name="", state=~"ESTABLISHED|TIME_WAIT|CLOSE_WAIT|SYN_RECV"}), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Process creation
panels.description: New processes per second (servers outside k8s). **Bad:** a sudden sustained jump: a fork loop or a crash-restarting service.

targets.expr: label_move(rate({__name__="system.processes.created", host.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval]), "host.name", "server")

panels.title: Running pods per k8s node
panels.description: Pods in phase Running. **Bad:** one node carrying most pods: rebalancing (descheduler) or anti-affinity is not working.

targets.expr: label_move(count by ("k8s.node.name") (max by ("k8s.node.name", "k8s.pod.uid") ({__name__="k8s.pod.phase", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}) == 2), "k8s.node.name", "server")

panels.title: k8s node Ready
panels.description: Kubelet Ready condition. Red: NotReady; pods there are not scheduled and get evicted after the toleration timeout.

targets.expr: label_move(max by ("k8s.node.name") ({__name__="k8s.node.condition_ready", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.node.name", "server")

panels.title: Top pods by CPU on these servers
panels.description: Noisy neighbours: the 10 pods using the most CPU on the selected k8s nodes. Click a series to open it.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") (rate({__name__="container.cpu.time", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])), "k8s.namespace.name", "namespace", "k8s.pod.name", "pod"))

panels.title: Top pods by memory on these servers
panels.description: Working set of the 10 largest pods on the selected k8s nodes.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") ({__name__="container.memory.working_set", k8s.node.name=~"$server"}), "k8s.namespace.name", "namespace", "k8s.pod.name", "pod"))

panels.title: Top pods by disk I/O on these servers
panels.description: Read + write bytes/s of the RBD PVCs mounted by each pod (CephFS traffic is not attributable).

targets.expr: topk_max(10, label_move(sum by ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") ((sum by ("host.name", device) (rate({__name__="system.disk.io", host.name=~"$server", device=~"rbd[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) * on ("host.name", device) group_right () (max by ("host.name", device, "k8s.pod.uid") (label_replace(label_replace({__name__="system.filesystem.utilization", host.name=~"$server", mountpoint=~"/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/pods/.*"}, "k8s.pod.uid", "$1", "mountpoint", "/var/lib/k0s/kubelet/pods/([^/]+)/.*"), "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.+)")) * 0 + 1)) * on ("k8s.pod.uid") group_left ("k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") (max by ("k8s.pod.uid", "k8s.namespace.name", "k8s.pod.name") ({__name__="k8s.pod.phase"}) * 0 + 1)), "k8s.namespace.name", "namespace", "k8s.pod.name", "pod"))
